featured_reviews.name: Nikhil Aher
featured_reviews.review_text:
🍰 Bandra Cakery by Bunty Mahajan – Truffle Desserts Done Exceptionally Well

Tried multiple desserts from Bandra Cakery by Bunty Mahajan, and the experience clearly reflects why this brand has such a strong reputation in Mumbai’s dessert scene.

I sampled the Dutch Truffle, Hazelnut Dutch Truffle, and Strawberry Dutch Truffle desserts. All three were rich, indulgent, and well-balanced, without being overly sweet.

The Dutch Truffle stood out with its deep chocolate flavour and smooth, creamy texture — classic, intense, and very satisfying.
The Hazelnut Dutch Truffle elevated the experience further, adding a nutty richness that paired beautifully with the chocolate, making it my personal favourite.
The Strawberry Dutch Truffle offered a refreshing contrast, with the slight tartness of strawberry cutting through the richness of the truffle base, making it lighter yet indulgent.

Portion sizes are generous, the quality of ingredients is evident, and the desserts feel premium from the first bite to the last. Packaging was neat and secure, ensuring the desserts arrived in excellent condition.

Overall, a solid choice for anyone who enjoys rich chocolate-based desserts with refined flavours.

featured_reviews.name: amin shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you find yourself in Khar, especially around Linking Road, Khobake & Co. is an absolute must-visit! This charming little cafe is a hidden gem, offering the perfect cozy atmosphere for a chill day out. Whether you’re looking to work, unwind with a book, or just indulge in some seriously amazing treats, this place has got you covered.
From the moment you step in, the aesthetic ambiance sweeps you into a relaxing vibe. It's one of those spots where you can just feel the warmth in the air—almost like the food is made with love (which, I'm sure it is). Whether you're driving a Benz or not, the vibe here feels upscale yet super welcoming.
What we tried:
Chocolicious Shake – Decadent and rich. A chocolate lover's dream.
Vietnamese Cold Coffee – Perfectly brewed and refreshing. Definitely a must-try for coffee enthusiasts.
Korean Cheese Bun – The combination of savory cheese in a soft bun? Simply unforgettable.
Chicken Puff – Light, flavorful, and packed with goodness.
Tandoori Chicken Croissant Sandwich – A beautiful fusion of crunchy croissant and tender chicken. A game changer!
Mocha Royale – The perfect balance of coffee and chocolate. A true indulgence.
Choco Chippy Tea Cake – This was hands-down the highlight of our visit. Soft, rich, and packed with little chocolate surprises. It's a must-try!
For dessert, you cannot miss:
Signature Vintage Petit Gateau – A slice of pure heaven with the perfect texture and flavor balance.
Tropical Coconut Punch Gateau – Light and refreshing, with the tropical flavors hitting just right.
In short, Khobake & Co. is not just a cafe, it's an experience. Whether you're here for the desserts, the drinks, or just to enjoy the ambiance, you’ll leave with a full heart (and a full stomach). Highly recommend if you're in the Khar area! 🧁

featured_reviews.name: Shubham Mishra
featured_reviews.review_text: In the United States, cakes usually are made by one of three methods. In the conventional method the sugar and fat are creamed together, the egg added, and a mixture of flour, salt, and baking powder mixed in alternately with the liquid, beginning and ending with dry ingredients. In the quick-dump, or one-bowl, method, all the ingredients except the leavening agent are put into a bowl and mixed vigorously (preferably with a power mixer), the leavening agent added, and mixing completed. As a modification of the method, the eggs and part of the milk may be added as a separate stage. The muffin method involves adding the combined liquid ingredients to the combined dry ingredients; but, although rapid and easy, this method unmodified produces a cake that tends to be coarse textured and to have poor keeping quality.

featured_reviews.name: NOSHIR KATRAK
featured_reviews.review_text:
Warden Bakery situated at August Kranti Maiden. Just next to Camy Wafer shop.
The name bakery itself is a self explanatory name where you can avail various biscuits, breads, pastries.
You can really enjoy the fresh baked breads, you name it and all sort of breads are available - Pizza, Dabeli, Garlic, Sweet, Regular breads to name a few.
Their pastries are exclusive, you will not find them at any other place.
The Almond tart, Butterscotch tart, Coconut biscuits, cream rolls, just fantastic, one cannot stop eating.
You can even purchase Mayoniese, Ketchups, different sauces required for preparing Pizzas and other tantalizing dishes.
Chocolate, Strawberry pastries - Oh My God!
Quick service and staff informs the customer to maintain safe distance.
It is open till 8.30 p.m.
Don't miss an opportunity to enjoy their mouth watering tarts, if one is present in the nearby area.

featured_reviews.name: Aatmi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Need burger buns, pizza bases, pita pockets for falafel, ladi pav, bread, snacks, pastries, chocolates, beverages, or sauces? You'll find it all at Warden Bakery.

They offer a wide variety of high-quality breads, spreads, snacks, and baked goods, with both whole wheat and refined flour options available. Everything is vegetarian, and Jain options can be arranged with advance notice. You can't go wrong with their breads 🍞 👍

A great one-stop shop for bakery essentials, snacks, and other supplies.
